# czc-v2026.10.24.2 (0.2.17.28)

User channel-status cards keep the monitor name on the first line. The
second line shows only the group name and a larger highlighted
multiplier.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.24.1

### Channel-status card header

- First line is the monitor name.
- Second line shows the group name and `×N` in a larger, primary-colored
  extra-bold face.
- A user-specific rate strikes through the group default and highlights
  the custom value.
- Peak-rate windows stay next to the multiplier when they apply.
- The provider badge and primary model are no longer on that second
  line.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.28`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in. No database migration and no configuration change.

Production remains on V1 probe. This release does not switch the
monitor mode.

## Compatibility

- Billing, probe routing, and V1/V2 monitor mode are unchanged.
- V2 matrix row labels are unchanged.
- Monitor detail dialogs still list models.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.24.1`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.24.2-<UTC timestamp>` created
during this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`. Rolling back restores
the previous card second line (provider badge, model, and GroupBadge).
Probe monitors and billing are unchanged.
